svg.aria-label: Four filter types: a transformer converts raw JSON data into a structured object; a tester checks input records and passes valid records while discarding duplicate ones; an enricher takes order data, looks up the customer in a customer database beside it, and produces an order with customer details; a splitter turns batch data into several records and a merger turns several records into aggregated data
svg.text: Transformers change form, testers pass or discard, enrichers add data, and splitters and mergers change the record count.
Converts input data from one format to another.
Checks input data and passes only the records that meet certain conditions.
Adds additional information to the input data from external sources.
Splits one input into multiple outputs or merges multiple inputs into a single output.
